sources.note: 31 March 1940; Finnish occupation 1941-1944; Isthmus to Leningrad Oblast September 1944; Ladoga Karelia stays; 16 July 1956 ASSR; area 172,400 km2 (1959); silent on Petsamo and the Winter War borders.

sources.title: Moscow Peace Treaty
sources.note: 12 March 1940: Finland cedes the Karelian Isthmus with Viipuri, the Ladoga shore, Salla and Rybachy.

notes: No Cliopatria row. Union republic from 31 March 1940 to 16 July 1956; the RSFSR dossier records the loss of the Karelian ASSR in 1940, the gain of the Isthmus in September 1944 and the return of Karelia in 1956. The page does not mention German forces (the occupation of 1941-1944 is Finland's), does not date the capital moves other than "1941-1944", and is silent on Petsamo (ceded by Finland in 1944), the Rybachy peninsula and Salla, whose republic is unknown. The Natural Earth Karelia contains Ladoga Karelia (Finnish until 1940); the Karelian ASSR proper is therefore Karelia minus a circle around Sortavala. Counterparts: republic-of-finland exists (Cliopatria); the RSFSR dossier is in this batch.
